The lawsuit accuses Meta of using powerful technologies to ensnare teens and of collecting data on children under 13 without parental consent. Meta denies the claims, pointing to teen accounts, parental controls and AI age detection. While the full $1.4 trillion is unlikely, even a fraction would be devastating.
